design_rule: Several catalog elements can map to one theme block or a snippet; do not mechanically make 192 element definitions into 192 or more separate theme blocks. Reserve room under the 300-file hard cap.
notes: Sections and nested blocks are related but have separate implementation limitations.
Section-defined blocks cannot be mixed with theme blocks in same section per Shopify docs.
App blocks are provided by apps and depend on schema support.
Editor settings must be merchant-understandable and instance-specific.
Nested theme block maximum of 8 levels excludes section level.
